title: Elizabeth White House
meta_description: Private Pool, Gulf Views, Near Seaside- Elizabeth White House
description_expanded: Description: Elizabeth White House by Royal Destinations Location: Seagrove Beach Address: 30 Thyme Street Details: Elizabeth White House is a spacious coastal retreat ideally situated in Old Seagrove, just 50 feet from Scenic Highway 30A with beach access directly across the street and Seaside only a short walk away. Offering approximately 2,897 square feet of interior living space and an additional 1,600 square feet of expansive balconies, this home comfortably accommodates up to 10 guests with four bedrooms, four full baths, and one half bath. Recently renovated bathrooms and kitchen spaces, two separate living areas, and multiple levels of indoor and outdoor gathering space make this an excellent choice for families traveling together. Outside, enjoy the private heated pool or relax on the home's expansive balconies overlooking the Gulf. The fourth-floor observation decks provide sweeping views of the Gulf and the rooftops of neighboring Seaside, while multiple outdoor dining and seating areas make it easy to enjoy the coastal setting throughout your stay. With convenient beach access, generous living spaces, and a location just minutes from Seaside, Elizabeth White House offers an exceptional setting for experiencing 30A. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: Approximately 50 Feet from 30A with Beach Access Directly Across -Distance to Seaside: Approximately 3-Minute Walk -Parking Spaces: (2) in Carport and (2) in Driveway -Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 8, Bar Seating for 4, Outdoor Dining for 8 -Coffee Maker Available: Keurig + Drip Coffee Maker -Private Heated Pool: 12’ x 24’* -(2) Living Areas -Expansive Gulf-View Balconies -Fourth-Floor Observation Decks with Gulf and Seaside Rooftop Views -Outdoor Shower and Foot Wash -Second-Floor Kitchenette -Whole-House Stereo -Outdoor Gas Grill *Pool heat is available for an additional $60 (pre-tax) per night and must be arranged prior to arrival. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 10 4 Bedrooms / 4.5 Baths First Floor: -Bedroom 1: King Bed with Private Bath (Walk-In Shower) -Laundry Room -Carport Second Floor: -Bedroom 2: Queen Bed -Bedroom 3 (Bunk Room): (2) Twin/Twin Bunks -(2) Full Baths: (1) Walk-In Shower and (1) Shower/Tub Combo with Double Vanity -Family Room -Kitchenette -Covered Balcony with Gulf Views Third Floor: -Bedroom 4 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Walk-In Shower, Separate Vanities, Water Closet), Sitting Room and Balcony Access -Kitchen / Main Living Room / Dining Area -Half Bath -Covered Balcony with Gulf Views and Outdoor Dining for 8 Fourth Floor: -East and West Observation Decks with Expansive Gulf and Seaside Rooftop Views Please Note: *On-street parking is not permitted. The property accommodates a maximum of (4) vehicles between the carport and driveway. *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
